newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank sets cash reserve requirements.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank sets cash reserve requirements.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said it would set a cash reserve requirement for the money market at 5.00 billion guilders for the period from June 27 to July 25.
The new reserve will replace a five-week cash arrangement of 5.01 billion guilders which expires on Friday June 27, before the start of trade.
All credit institutions must maintain a compulsory cash reserve at the central bank. The average volume for the cash reserve arrangement is set in advance for four to five weeks.
The amount of the cash reserve is calculated as a percentage of an institution's reserve base.
